questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and fourth term related to third term.

11 ∶ 1309 ∶∶ 15 ∶ 3345 ∶∶ 7 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The pattern in the given series is:

**First term × {(first term)² - 2} = Second term **

Let's apply the pattern on the given series: **
** In 11 ∶**** 1309**

First term × {(first term)2 - 2} = Second term

11 × {(11)² - 2} = 1309 

11 × {121 - 2} = 1309

11 × {119} = 1309

1309 = 1309 

 In** **15 ****∶**** 3345**

First term × {(first term)2 - 2} = Second term

​15 × {(15)2 - 2} = 3345 
15 × {225 - 2} = 3345
15 × {223} = 3345
3345 = 3345 

In **7 ∶ ?**
First term × {(first term)2 - 2} = Second term
​7 × {(7)2 - 2} = Second term
7 × {49 - 2} = Second term
7 × {47} = Second term
**329 = Second term**

Hence **the correct answer is 329.**

questions.question: Tamanna started her walk at 6 a.m. On her way she saw a tree in front of her. She noted that the shadow of the tree was exactly to her left. In which direction was Tamanna walking?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Tamanna started her walk at 6 a.m. On her way, she saw a tree in front of her. She noted that the shadow of the tree was exactly to her left. 

As it is given 6 a.m., therefore it is morning and the sun rises from east. 

As it is given shadow of the tree was exactly to Tamanna's left, it means the sun was to to her right.

So, sun rises from the east, and the shadow of the tree falls to her left, it means Tamanna's right side would be east.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2094a4a27d8a496076fe6a5969f662dbbd34cec8150e8846ae4d95ba6d8114a3.png] 

Thus, Tamanna is walking in the north direction.

Hence,** "Option 2" **is the correct answer.

questions.question: In the following question, select the odd word pair from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
The pairs "Pedal - Cycle", "Room - House", and "Chapter - Book" represent a part-whole relationship, where the first item is an integral part of the second item:

 
• A pedal is an integral part of a cycle.
 
• A room is an integral part of a house.
 
• A chapter is an integral part of a book.

However, the pair "Fan - Blade" doesn't follow the same pattern. Here, blade is integral part of Fan which should second part not first part.

Therefore, "Fan - Blade" is the odd pair out, as the first item doesn't necessarily include the second item.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(26, 19, 315)

(17, 13, 120)

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **(1st number)² - (2nd number)² = 3rd number**.

Now,

(26, 19, 315)

→ (26)² - (19)²

→ 676 - 361 = 315.

(17, 13, 120)

→ (17)2 - (13)2

→ 289 - 169 = 120.

Similarly, for **(23, 15, 304)**

**→ (23)2 - (15)2**

**→ 529 - 225 = 304.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

The logic followed here is :-

**Third number = (First number + Second number) × (First number - Second number)**

(26, 19, 315) → (26 + 19) × (26 - 19) = 45 × 7 = 315

And

(17, 13, 120) → (17 + 13) × (17 - 13) = 30 × 4 = 120

Similarly,

**(23, 15, 304) → (23 + 15) × (23 - 15) = 38 × 8 = 304**

Hence, the correct answer is **"(23, 15, 304)".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

Vaccine ∶ Prevent ∶ ∶ Medicine ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:** Relationship between a product and its purpose.**

Here,

Vaccine : Prevent → **Vaccine** is used to **prevent** diseases.

Similarly,

Medicine : Cure → **Medicine** is used to **cure** diseases.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.question:

289 ∶ 19 ∶∶ 361 ∶ ? ∶∶ 476 ∶ 17
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is,

**abc : n (a + b + c)**

Where a, b, and c are the initial 3-digit numbers of the series (a + b+ c = n) and n is the second 2- digit number.

⇒ 2 +8 + 9 = 19

⇒ 4 +7 + 6 = 17 

Similarly,

⇒ 3 + 6 + 1 = 10

​Hence, the correct answer is **"10".**
